idea-plugin.name: Base Image EOL Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Marks every base image in your Dockerfiles, compose files and CI workflows whose security patches have already stopped - or stop before 13 November 2026 - and prints the tag that replaces it.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Base Image EOL Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 21 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/base-image-eol-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/base-image-eol-lint

action.text: Base Image EOL Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run Base Image EOL Lint on the file in the editor
